verdict.rationale: Insomnia ships an official 'Inso CLI' documented for running tests, linting OpenAPI specs, and CI automation, confirmed by dedicated docs and a probe hit at /inso-cli/. However, the evidence never frames the CLI as AI-native or agent-oriented (no mention of AI agents invoking it, no JSON/agent-friendly output modes, no positioning for autonomous agent workflows) — it's presented purely as a human/CI automation tool. missing for 10: evidence of AI-agent-specific design or usage of the CLI, agent-friendly output/interfaces, independent hands-on confirmation of CLI capabilities.
